question: The simple interest on ₹1,280 at 5% p.a. in 3 years is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The effective rate of **interest** for 3 years at 5% per annum = 5% × 3 = **15%**.

Calculate 15% of the **Principal** (₹1,280):

10% of 1,280 = 128 and 5% of 1,280 = 64.

Total **Simple Interest** = 128 + 64 = ₹192.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹192.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹1,280

Rate of Interest (R) = 5% p.a.

Time period (T) = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d8e746a79d79d6b62b26b81c9dacc76c85ff39121e27f73f0ccf08ff7b1faa64.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI = (1280 × 5 × 3) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = (1280 × 15) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 19200 ÷ 100

⇒ SI = ₹192

**∴ The correct answer is ₹192.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relationship between SI and Amount

The total **Amount** (A) is calculated by adding the **Principal** (P) and the **Simple Interest** (SI): A = P + SI.

Constant Interest Property

In **Simple Interest**, the interest earned remains the same every year because it is always calculated on the original **Principal**.

Interest Rate Conversion

If the **Time** is given in months, divide it by 12 to convert it into years; if given in days, divide by 365 before applying the formula.
